source: Freistaat Bayern, Bayerisches Landesamt fuer Umwelt (LfU): Naturdenkmale, punktfoermig (point-shaped nature monuments)
licence_proof: The WFS GetCapabilities response (ows:Fees element) states verbatim: 'Der Datensatz/Dienst steht unter der Lizenz: Creative Commons Namensnennung 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Die Namensnennung des Bayerischen Landesamtes fuer Umwelt als Rechteinhaber hat in folgender Weise zu erfolgen: "Datenquelle: Bayerisches Landesamt fuer Umwelt, www.lfu.bayern.de".' (fetched from the live GetCapabilities response, 2026-08-13)
attribution: Datenquelle: Bayerisches Landesamt fuer Umwelt, www.lfu.bayern.de (required by the CC BY 4.0 licence, verbatim wording as specified above)
scope: All 4860 point-shaped Naturdenkmal features statewide (Bayern), fetched in full via paginated GetFeature (count=1000, startIndex 0/1000/2000/3000/4000). This is the ND (Naturdenkmal Einzelschoepfungen) point layer only; the areal layer (naturdenkmal_flaechig) and the separate landschaftsbestandteil layers (a weaker local-protection category, not Naturdenkmal) were NOT fetched this pass. 311 of 4860 features carry more than one point in their geometry (a MultiPoint), i.e. are twin/group entries the same as Berlin's twins; 'point_count' on each entry flags this so a verification pass folds or splits deliberately rather than by accident.
caveat: No species field and no age field at all, thinner than even Berlin's register: only webgisid, ID, NAME, STATUS and geometry (confirmed via DescribeFeatureType, 2026-08-13). Species must usually be read out of the free-text NAME field ('ND Nr. 26 Platane in der Gruebelstrasse' names the species and a street; many others just say 'Naturdenkmal Eiche' or 'Naturdenkmal 1 Linde' with no place hint at all beyond coordinates). STATUS is a legal-designation flag ('aktuell' on 4858 of 4860, 'einstweilig sichergestellt' i.e. provisionally secured on 2), not a vitality field: a tree can be legally 'aktuell' and biologically dead, so alive-now is always a per-tree check exactly as BRIEF_RESEARCH.md requires. Coordinates are the WFS's own point(s) per feature, requested directly in EPSG:4326 (srsName parameter), no reprojection performed; native storage CRS is EPSG:25832 (UTM32N) per the raw GML pointMember output, so if a future fetch omits srsName the coordinates will come back as UTM32N metres, not lat/lon, and must be reprojected before use. This register is a lead list for the semantic filter and coordinates, not a source for species, age or vitality: a verification pass still needs the normal two independent sources per candidate.

Nuremberg.note: The Kontumazgarten/Hallerwiese cluster (17 trees within 2km of city centre, mostly planes, red beeches and limes, several within 100-200m of each other) is a genuinely walkable candidate cluster, comparable in density to Cadiz.

Regensburg.note: Thin near the centre (1 within 2km: 'Naturdenkmal Kastanien am Gries', 1.16km out); the rest spread 3-15km out into the surrounding Landkreis, several beyond the 30-minute day-trip boundary.

Bamberg.note: Nothing within 2km of the old-town centre; nearest cluster starts around 2.1km (several oaks and limes 2-4km out). Worth checking whether the historic centre itself (Domberg, Hain park) has any trees the ND layer missed, since a UNESCO old town is exactly the kind of ground CLAUDE.md's search order expects to hold uncatalogued trees.

Rothenburg ob der Tauber.note: Small but real cluster (4 limes/spruces/a pear tree within 2km, the nearest 0.72km out).
